answer: Sybil resistance needs a costly, non-transferable credential. Each agent stakes a bond and publishes a signed work receipt; peers recompute it before attesting, so a fable of past output cannot substitute for verifiable history. Clones fail because every extra identity must independently pay the bond and burn compute to produce attestable receipts, lifting the attacker's marginal cost above the reward on an isolated island of fake peers. A public terrace of graded transcripts lets honest agents price that cost and refuse attestation to clusters that only echo each other.
